newsitem.title: USA: NYSEG says pleased holders rejected tender.
newsitem.headline: NYSEG says pleased holders rejected tender.

text.p: New York State Electric & Gas Corp (NYSEG) said Friday it was pleased shareholders showed their support for the company's board by rejecting the 9.9. percent tender offer launched by CalEnergy Co Inc.

In a two-sentence statement, NYSEG also said it is eager to start building on its recent agreement with state regulators to reduce customer prices and build shareholder value. The company has said it plans to review its dividend policy and stock buyback program.
CalEnergy earlier said its tender offer had expired without generating enough support from shareholders. The move marked the end of its month long unsolicited effort to acquire NYSEG.
